products.name: Lilac Reverie
products.desc: Four clouded-glass blossoms cluster around a single pavé centre, with small zircon accents catching light between the petals. The pale lilac tone shifts against the background.

products.name: Serpentine Psalm
products.desc: A serpent silhouette in pale turquoise and oxblood enamel, balanced by two small ruby-tone glass drops. The long curve frames the jaw and catches light as you move.

products.name: Morpho Nocturne
products.desc: An iridescent wing in layered resin, set into gold-tone filigree with a faceted black centre stone. The colour shifts from cobalt to green as the angle changes.

products.name: Nocturne of the Deep
products.desc: Four small sea-creature pins in silver-tone metal: a shell, a pearl-tone bead, a coral branch and a long filament form. Worn together, they read as a found set.

products.name: Coral Reliquary
products.desc: Teardrops of coral-tone glass wrapped in gold-tone filigree, with a small blue-green resin cabochon at the crown and a pair of zircon drops.

products.name: Opaline Arch Cuff
products.desc: An open arch in gold-tone metal, set with four opal-tone resin panels and a border of zircon. The articulated sections flex around the wrist.

products.name: Two Doves
products.desc: Two doves in silver-tone metal turn toward one another around a faceted yellow-glass briolette. Zircon traces the wings, and the clasp hides within the tail of the left bird.
